scripts.dev: concurrently "cd worker && wrangler dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.deploy: cd worker && wrangler deploy && cd ../frontend && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:schema: cd worker && wrangler d1 execute thetide-db --file=../database/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: cd worker && wrangler d1 execute thetide-db --file=../database/seed.sql
